questions.stem: What do you use to change TV channels?
questions.explain:
change TV channels: 切換電視頻道
remote: 遙控器
flashlight: 手電筒
解析：題目詢問「你用什麼來切換電視頻道？」。遙控器英文常簡稱為 remote（全名 remote control），故答案選D。干擾選項 A 手電筒、B 微波爐、C 冰箱均為其他常見居家設備或工具，與轉台功能無關，純屬名詞辨析陷阱。

questions.stem: Which of the following is a building for storing military weapons?
questions.explain:
arsenal: 軍火庫、兵工廠
store: 儲存
military weapon: 軍用武器
解析：題目詢問何者為存放軍事武器的建築。arsenal 意為軍火庫，符合題意故答案選A。干擾選項 B 車庫 與 D 衣櫥 雖具存放功能但非軍事設施，C 出口 則與存放武器完全無關。

questions.stem: You look so pathetic. What's wrong?

options.D: I was dumped by my girlfriend.

questions.explain:
pathetic: 可憐的、狼狽的
hit the jackpot: 中大獎
dump: 甩掉、拋棄
解析：題意為「你看起來很可憐，怎麼了？」，需回答負面遭遇，故答案選D「我被女友甩了」。干擾選項A中大獎、B得獎學金、C升官皆為令人開心的好事，與慘況的語境相反。

questions.stem: Are you fussy about food?

options.B: No, I'm not a good cook.
options.C: Yes, I'm fond of junk food.

questions.explain:
be fussy about: 對…挑剔
I'm easy: 我很隨和、我不挑剔
be fond of: 喜愛
解析：題意為「你對食物挑剔嗎？」。答案選D，I'm easy 口語表示「我很隨和、不挑剔」，符合語意。選項A利用發音相近的 busy 設下聽力陷阱；B 偏離主題誤導為下廚廚藝；C 僅提及喜愛垃圾食物，未正面回應是否挑食。

questions.stem: Did you get drunk last night?

options.A: No, I didn't get a wink of sleep last night.
options.B: Yes, I drank coffee before going to bed.
options.C: No, I didn't think too much about that.
options.D: Yes, I still have a hangover now.

questions.explain:
get drunk: 喝醉
hangover: 宿醉
not get a wink of sleep: 徹夜未眠
解析：題意問「你昨晚喝醉了嗎？」，答案選D，因現在還宿醉與昨晚喝醉的情境相符。選項B用喝咖啡混淆喝醉酒，A答非所問說沒睡著，C則是利用think與drunk/drink發音相近的聽力干擾陷阱。

questions.stem: Is the book available in local bookstores?

options.B: Yes, I borrowed it from the library.
options.D: Yes, I enjoy reading comic book.

questions.explain:
available: 可買到的
out of print: 絕版
解析：題意詢問這本書在當地書店是否買得到。選項A說明「已絕版」，合理交代買不到的原因，故答案選A。干擾項B提到圖書館借閱、C回答價格不貴、D說明個人喜好，皆答非所問，偏離書店有無販售的核心。

questions.stem: How often do you go shopping?

options.A: I often go to that shopping mall, too.
options.C: I like to go shopping with my family.

questions.explain:
How often: 多常（詢問頻率）
depend on: 取決於、看…而定
mood: 心情
解析：題目問「你多常去購物？」是在詢問頻率，答案選B「看我心情而定」，符合語意。選項A重複often與shopping是字面陷阱；C回答同行對象；D表示由你決定，皆答非所問。

questions.stem: Could you please page a friend for me?

options.A: Sorry, I forgot to remind your friend.
options.C: Sorry, I forgot to invite him.
options.D: Sure, I'll give him the message.

questions.explain:
page: (透過廣播)呼叫、尋找
remind: 提醒
解析：題幹中的 page 為動詞，指「在公共場所透過廣播尋人」。請求協助廣播找人時，對方最合理的反應是答應並詢問朋友姓名，故答案選B。選項 A、C、D 均不合邏輯，錯在將廣播尋人的動作誤解為一般的提醒、邀請或轉達訊息。

questions.stem: Is there a lavatory on the bus?

options.B: Yes, you may use it when you need to.
options.D: Yes, there is a laboratory there.

questions.explain:
lavatory: 廁所、洗手間
occupied: 有人使用的
laboratory: 實驗室
解析：題目詢問公車上是否有廁所。選項B正面回答有且需要時可使用，故答案選B。選項A邏輯矛盾，長途巴士通常會有廁所；選項D利用發音相近的laboratory（實驗室）設下聽力陷阱；選項C回答沒有卻說未被佔用，前後語意不合。

questions.stem: Why do different countries have different taboos?
questions.explain:
taboo: 禁忌
cultural difference: 文化差異
racial discrimination: 種族歧視
解析：題意為「為什麼不同的國家有不同的禁忌？」。禁忌通常源自各地的文化背景與生活習俗，因此答案選A。干擾選項B「種族歧視」、C「政治動盪」及D「社會正義」雖同為社會相關名詞，但皆非構成各國日常民俗禁忌的核心主因，為語意邏輯陷阱。

questions.stem: Do you take public transportation or drive to work?

options.B: I usually get to work before 8:30.
options.D: I walk the dog before going to work.

questions.explain:
public transportation: 大眾運輸
subway: 地鐵、捷運
shift: 輪班
解析：題目詢問搭大眾運輸還是開車上班，屬於選擇疑問句。地鐵屬於大眾運輸，故答案選A。選項B回答到校或上班時間、C回答輪班、D講出門前遛狗，皆受work字面重複干擾且答非所問。

questions.stem: Is that a normal procedure?

options.A: No, it's not a formal procedure.
options.C: No, it's not a simple procedure.

questions.explain:
normal procedure: 正常程序
standard procedure: 標準程序
faulty: 有瑕疵的
解析：題意問「那是正常的程序嗎？」。normal 與 standard 意思相近，皆指合乎規定的標準程序，因此答案選D。干擾選項A是利用與 normal 押韻的 formal（正式的）製造發音陷阱；B選項的 faulty（有瑕疵的）則與肯定句前後語意矛盾。

questions.stem: Do you know how to use chopsticks?

options.A: Yes, they are used in Chinese restaurants.
options.C: Yes, I'm used to using them now.
options.D: No, they are not difficult to use.

questions.explain:
chopsticks: 筷子
be used to: 習慣於
解析：題目問「你會用筷子嗎？」，答案選C，表示「會，我現在習慣使用了」，符合日常應答邏輯。選項A僅說明中餐館有使用，答非所問；選項B誤將筷子當成地點；選項D回答「不會」後卻接「它們不難用」，前後語意矛盾。

questions.stem: Which way should I insert the ticket?

options.A: It's a sensor ticket. You don't need to insert it.
options.B: The best way is to buy tickets online.
options.C: It's the most expensive ticket I've ever bought.
options.D: No way! I won't give you the ticket.

questions.explain:
insert: 插入
sensor ticket: 感應式票券
which way: 朝哪個方向
解析：題意為「我該朝哪個方向插入票卡？」。答案選A，說明是感應票不需插入，切合情境。選項B（best way）與D（No way）是利用多義字way設下的字面陷阱；選項C扯到票價則是答非所問。

questions.stem: Are they planning their wedding now?

options.A: Yes, they're going to get married.
options.B: No, they aren't going to take a walk.
options.D: No, they'll remain in their seats.

questions.explain:
wedding: 婚禮
get married: 結婚
plan: 計畫、籌備
解析：題意為「他們現在正在籌備婚禮嗎？」。wedding（婚禮）與 get married（結婚）意思相呼應，故答案選A。其餘選項B（散步）、C（退休）及D（留在座位上）的情境皆與籌辦婚禮毫無關聯，純屬文不對題的干擾項。

questions.stem: Is your mother very thrifty?

options.A: No, she's not very strict with us
options.B: Yes, she is very generous to us.
options.C: No, she's not easy to persuade.
options.D: Yes, she is very careful when spending money.

questions.explain:
thrifty: 節儉的
strict: 嚴格的
generous: 慷慨的
解析：題意為「你母親很節儉嗎？」。thrifty 意為節省，與 D 的花錢謹慎意思相符，故答案選D。選項 A 的 strict（嚴格）為拼字與發音相近的干擾；選項 B 的 generous（大方慷慨）則與題意相反。

questions.stem: How can I upgrade to first class?

options.A: You need to place a down payment.
options.C: You need to buy new software.
options.D: You need to have enough air miles.

questions.explain:
upgrade: 升等、升級
first class: 頭等艙
air miles: 航空里程
down payment: 頭期款
解析：題目詢問如何升等到頭等艙，答案選D，因累積足夠的航空里程可兌換機位升等。選項B將class誤解為學校課程或班級；選項C把upgrade誤當作電腦軟體升級；選項A支付頭期款是用於購屋或購車，均不符合搭乘飛機的情境。

questions.stem: Who should you call to repair the water pipes?
questions.explain:
repair: 修理
water pipe: 水管
plumber: 水管工人
解析：題意為「你該找誰修水管？」plumber 指水管工人，專門負責維修管線，故答案選D。選項 A 是礦工（miner）、B 是收銀員（cashier）、C 是銀行家（banker），工作性質皆與修繕水管無關。

questions.stem: You are such a party animal. Why?

options.A: It has something to do with animal rights.
options.C: It is a good way to socialize with people.

questions.explain:
party animal: 派對狂、熱衷派對的人
socialize: 社交、交際
have something to do with: 與……有關
解析：題意為「你真是個派對狂，為什麼？」，詢問熱愛派對的原因。選項C說明派對是與人社交的好方式，符合邏輯，答案選C。選項A取animal字面延伸為動物權利，B與D則將party曲解為政黨，皆為一字多義的字面陷阱。

questions.stem: Do you live alone?

options.C: Yes, I live all by myself.

questions.explain:
live alone: 獨自居住
all by oneself: 獨自一人
解析：題目詢問「你一個人住嗎？」。片語 all by myself 即「獨自一人」，與 alone 同義，故答案選C。選項 A 改回答父母的情況，答非所問；B 提父母過世、D 提尚未結婚，皆無法直接回答目前是否獨居，屬於邏輯離題的干擾選項。

questions.stem: Where can I buy some small gifts for my family?
questions.explain:
souvenir shop: 紀念品店
grocery store: 雜貨店
furniture store: 家具店
解析：題目詢問哪裡可以買些小禮物給家人，買禮物最合適的地點就是紀念品店，因此答案選C。主要干擾選項中，A為美容院、B為雜貨店、D為家具店，皆非專門購買小禮物的場所，不符合題意情境。

questions.stem: Are you cooperative at work?

options.A: Yes, I'm able to play some musical instruments.
options.B: No, I've never worked so late.
options.C: Yes, I am good at working with people.
options.D: No, I don't want to work overtime.

questions.explain:
cooperative: 樂意合作的
be good at: 擅長於
work overtime: 加班
解析：題目詢問「你在工作上善於合作嗎？」，cooperative 表示與他人協力配合，故答案選C（我擅長與人共事）。干擾選項 B 與 D 抓到 work 字面延伸至加班或工時，A 則扯到演奏樂器，皆答非所問。

questions.stem: Which of the following is a renewable source of energy?
questions.explain:
renewable source of energy: 可再生能源
solar power: 太陽能
fossil fuel: 化石燃料
解析：題目詢問何者是可再生能源。太陽能取之不盡且能自然循環補充，故答案選A。干擾選項B煤炭、C化石燃料與D石油皆為耗盡即無法短時間再生的傳統石化能源，屬於反向概念陷阱。

questions.stem: What is Air Force One?

options.A: It refers to an air force commander.
options.B: It refers to an air force base.
options.C: It is the plane used by the U.S. President.
options.D: It is a weapon system used by the air force.

questions.explain:
Air Force One: 空軍一號（美總統專機）
refer to: 指的是、意指
commander: 指揮官
解析：題目詢問什麼是「空軍一號」。Air Force One 專指搭載美國現任總統的空軍飛機，故答案選C。選項A的指揮官、B的基地及D的武器系統，皆是利用 air force 字面延伸的軍事名詞干擾選項，並非該專有名詞的定義。

questions.stem: Where can I find sugar in this supermarket?
questions.explain:
supermarket: 超市
aisle: 走道、貨架通道
information desk: 服務台
解析：題意為「這家超市的糖在哪裡？」詢問商品陳列位置，答案選B，超市各走道（aisle）擺放各類食品最合常理。干擾選項A的大廳（lobby）多用於飯店或大樓；C服務台為諮詢處而非陳列貨品處；D回答時間，不符地點提問。

questions.stem: The child is a pain in the neck.

options.A: The child is suffering a pain.
options.B: The child is afraid of pain.

questions.explain:
a pain in the neck: 令人討厭的人或事物
annoying: 惱人的、討厭的
解析：題幹 a pain in the neck 為慣用語，形容某人或事物「令人頭痛、非常討厭」，故答案選C。選項A與B落入字面陷阱，把 pain 誤解為身體實質的疼痛或怕痛；選項D指肚子餓，與題意完全無關。

questions.stem: Both sides have agreed to a ceasefire.

options.A: Both sides are suspicious of each other.
options.B: Both sides are willing to stop fighting.
options.C: Both sides are ready to attack each other.
options.D: Both sides are sending more troops to war.

questions.explain:
ceasefire: 停火、停戰
agree to: 同意
be willing to: 願意
解析：題意為雙方已同意停火。ceasefire意為停止戰鬥，與選項B的stop fighting同義，故答案選B。選項C表示準備攻擊、選項D表示增派部隊參戰，均與「停火」語意完全相反；選項A指雙方互相懷疑，題幹並未提及，為無關干擾。

questions.stem: Good products speak for themselves.

options.C: Good products save time and money.

questions.explain:
speak for itself: 不言而喻、無需多言
product: 產品
advertising: 廣告
解析：題目意為「好的產品會自己說話」，比喻品質優良自能證明其價值，不需多做宣傳，因此答案選B。選項D意思完全相反；選項A指壽命較長、C指省時省錢，雖皆為好產品的優點，但偏離片語本身的涵義。

questions.stem: The answer he gave was a vague one.

options.A: His answer was not clear enough.

questions.explain:
vague: 模糊的、不明確的
straightforward: 直截了當的
satisfactory: 令人滿意的
解析：題意為「他給的答案很模糊」。vague 意為模糊、不清楚，與 not clear enough 同義，故答案選A。選項B太長與C不令人滿意皆屬過度推論；D的 straightforward（坦率直接）則是 vague 的反義字陷阱。

questions.stem: I first met Sarah when we went to a banquet.

options.A: I first met sarah at a theater.
options.B: I first met Sarah at a library.
options.C: I first met Sarah at a dinner party.
options.D: I first met Sarah at a speech contest.

questions.explain:
banquet: 宴會、盛宴
dinner party: 晚宴、餐會
speech contest: 演講比賽
解析：題意為「我第一次遇見莎拉是在參加宴會的時候」。banquet 指正式大型宴會，與 C 選項的 dinner party 意思相符，故答案選C。干擾選項 A 的 theater（劇院）、B 的 library（圖書館）及 D 的 speech contest（演講比賽）均為不同活動場所的字面干擾。

questions.stem: We often dress down on Fridays.

options.A: We often have to work overtime on Fridays.
options.B: We often wear informal clothes on Fridays.
options.C: We often feel down on Fridays
options.D: We often eat out on Fridays.

questions.explain:
dress down: 穿著休閒便服
informal clothes: 便服、非正式服裝
feel down: 心情低落
解析：題意為我們週五常穿便服。dress down 指穿著非正式的休閒服裝，故答案選B。選項C利用同字 down 設計陷阱，但 feel down 是心情沮喪；選項A加班與D外食則與衣著完全無關。

questions.stem: Our cabin overlooks a beautiful mountain lake.

options.A: Our cabin is built on a beautiful mountain lake.
options.B: Our cabin is located next to a beautiful mountain lake.
options.C: Our cabin adds to the beauty of the mountain lake.
options.D: Our cabin enables us to see a beautiful mountain lake below.

questions.explain:
cabin: 小木屋
overlook: 俯瞰、眺望
enable: 使能夠
解析：題意是「我們的小木屋俯瞰美麗的高山湖泊」。動詞 overlook 指從高處往下看，與選項 D 的 see below 相符，故答案選D。選項 A「建在湖上」及 B「在湖旁邊」皆為空間方位的字面陷阱，忽略了居高臨下俯瞰的涵義。

questions.stem: These products are out of stock.

options.A: These products are made by hand.
options.B: These products are very popular now.
options.C: These products are made of stone.
options.D: These products are not available now.

questions.explain:
out of stock: 缺貨、無現貨
available: 可取得的、可買到的
解析：題意為「這些產品缺貨了」。片語 out of stock 指沒有庫存，與 not available 同義，故答案選D。選項C的 stone 為 stock 的音近干擾陷阱；選項A手工製造與選項B很受歡迎則偏離題意。

questions.stem: We were all exhausted when we got back.

options.A: We were very satisfied when we got back.
options.B: We were all shocked when we got back.
options.C: We were all very excited when we got back.
options.D: We were all tired out when we got back.

questions.explain:
exhausted: 精疲力竭的
tired out: 筋疲力盡
解析：題意為「我們回去時都精疲力竭了」。exhausted 與 tired out 為同義片語，故答案選D。主要干擾項 C 的 excited 與題幹 exhausted 發音開頭相似，A（滿意的）及 B（震驚的）語意皆不符。

questions.stem: Lisa is a great gossip at work.

options.B: She enjoys working on her own.
options.D: She enjoys talking about other people.

questions.explain:
gossip: 愛說長道短的人、八卦
on one's own: 獨自一人
efficient: 有效率的
解析：題幹中 gossip 指愛聊他人私事的是非之人，也就是喜歡談論別人，故答案選D。選項A認真工作、B喜歡獨立作業及C工作效率高，皆屬於正面描述工作態度的干擾選項，完全偏離愛聊八卦的原意。

questions.stem: The temperature may drop below freezing tonight.

options.B: It may rain cats and dogs tonight.

questions.explain:
temperature: 氣溫
drop below freezing: 降至冰點以下
rain cats and dogs: 下傾盆大雨
解析：題意為今晚氣溫可能降至冰點以下。低於零度最可能出現的降水型態為下雪，故答案選D。A選項變暖與drop降溫相反；B選項下暴雨及C選項暴風雨皆為無法直接推論的氣候干擾。

questions.stem: They're going to sign an armistice.

options.A: They are going to sign a legal document.
options.B: They are going to sign a lease.
options.C: They are going to sign a marriage contract.
options.D: They are going to sign a cease-fire agreement.

questions.explain:
armistice: 停戰協定，休戰
cease-fire: 停火
lease: 租約
解析：題目表示「他們即將簽署停戰協定」。armistice 指戰事暫停的協議，與 cease-fire agreement 同義，故答案選D。選項B的 lease（租約）與選項C的 marriage contract（婚約）皆為民事合約干擾項，與軍事停戰無關。

questions.stem: The construction industry is labor-intensive.

options.A: The construction industry needs a lot of investments.
options.B: The construction industry needs a lot of promotion.
options.C: The construction industry needs a lot of workers.
options.D: The construction industry needs a lot of attention.

questions.explain:
construction industry: 營造業
labor-intensive: 勞力密集的
解析：題意為營造業是勞力密集產業。labor指勞工，labor-intensive即需要大量人力，故答案選C。干擾項A（投資）、B（推廣）與D（關注）皆非labor的意涵，屬於字義延伸的干擾。

questions.stem: These windows are made of bullet-proof glass.

options.C: These windows can resist strong winds.

questions.explain:
bullet-proof: 防彈的
resist: 抵擋、抵抗
fragile: 易碎的
解析：題意為這些窗戶是由防彈玻璃製成的。字尾-proof表示防護，能防彈即抵擋子彈（resist bullets），故答案選A。選項B fragile（易碎的）意思完全相反；選項C強風與選項D防震（shock-proof）則是替換受詞與字首的字面干擾。

questions.stem: Tommy refuses to go to bed without his teddy bear.

options.A: Tommy must have his teddy bear with him when going to bed.
options.B: Tommy is getting tired of his teddy bear.
options.C: Tommy refuses to go to bed without being told a story.
options.D: Tommy is expecting to get a new teddy bear.

questions.explain:
refuse: 拒絕
without: 沒有、缺少
get tired of: 對…感到厭倦
解析：題意為湯米睡覺時如果沒有泰迪熊就會拒絕上床，雙重否定代表睡覺時「必須有」泰迪熊陪伴，故答案選A。B選項的厭倦與題意完全相反；C選項的聽故事與D選項的期待新熊皆屬於無中生有的干擾選項。

questions.stem: I'm hungry, but I don't want to eat those leftovers.

options.A: I want to eat more vegetarian food.
options.B: I am not particular about food.
options.C: I want to eat something freshly cooked.
options.D: I am not interested in exotic foods.

questions.explain:
leftovers: 剩菜剩飯
freshly cooked: 現做的、剛煮好的
be particular about: 對...講究或挑剔
解析：題意為「我很餓，但我不想吃那些剩菜」。leftovers是剩菜，不想吃剩菜表示想吃剛煮好的食物，故答案選C。干擾項A的素食、B的不挑食及D的異國美食皆屬無關的過度推論，偏離原意。

questions.stem: Lieutenant Lee is being debriefed right now.

options.A: He is being asked questions about his recent mission.
options.B: He is on sick leave today.
options.C: He is being praised for his good performance.
options.D: He is on his way back to camp now.

questions.explain:
Lieutenant: 中尉
debrief: 任務後聽取報告、詢問情況
mission: 任務
解析：題幹表示李中尉正在接受任務詢問。軍事用語 debrief 指任務結束後向人員詢問細節以蒐集情資，故答案選A。B項請病假、C項受表揚、D項返回營區，均與任務後的訊問無關，純屬軍中日常情境的干擾選項。

questions.stem: Robert works part-time as a caddy.

options.A: He works part-time at a supermarket.
options.B: He works part-time at a golf course.
options.C: He works part-time at a restaurant.
options.D: He works part-time at a flower shop.

questions.explain:
part-time: 兼職的
caddy: 高爾夫球桿弟
golf course: 高爾夫球場
解析：題意是羅伯特兼職當桿弟。caddy專指高爾夫球場上協助球員背球袋的球童，因此其工作地點必在高爾夫球場，答案選B。選項A超市、C餐廳與D花店皆與桿弟的專業工作場所無關，屬於替換地點的干擾選項。

questions.stem: It's the straw that breaks the camel's back.

options.C: I can't make up my mind.

questions.explain:
the straw that breaks the camel's back: 壓垮駱駝的最後一根稻草
can't stand: 無法忍受
make up one's mind: 下定決心
解析：題幹成語指「壓垮駱駝的最後一根稻草」，比喻讓人忍無可忍的最後致命打擊，故答案選A。選項B（好的開始）、C（無法決定）與D（最後的希望）皆偏離成語原意，屬於字面或語意干擾。

questions.stem: It is a feature article about weather change.

options.A: It is a special report on weather change.
options.C: It is a TV program about weather change.
options.D: It is an effort to deal with weather change.

questions.explain:
feature article: 專題報導、特寫文章
special report: 特別報導、專題報告
weather forecast: 天氣預報
解析：題意指這是一篇關於氣候變化的專題報導。feature article 等同於 special report，故答案選A。干擾選項B的 weather forecast 是天氣預報；C把文章（article）混淆成電視節目；D則偏離報導形式，皆為不合題意的字面陷阱。

questions.stem: All TV stations want to increase their ratings.

options.A: All TV stations want to increase their revenues.
options.B: All TV stations want to increase their staff members.
options.C: All TV stations want to increase the number of their viewers.
options.D: All TV stations want to increase their programs.

questions.explain:
ratings: 收視率
increase: 增加
viewer: 觀眾
解析：題幹 ratings 指電視的「收視率」，也就是看電視的人數，故答案選C。選項 A 的 revenues（營收）、B 的 staff members（員工）與 D 的 programs（節目）雖常與電視台聯想在一起，屬於情境干擾，但皆非 ratings 的意思。

questions.stem: I left my carry-on bag on the plane.

options.C: I checked in my carry-on bag.
options.D: I forgot about my carry-on bag.

questions.explain:
carry-on bag: 隨身行李
leave on: 把某物遺忘在...
check in: 託運
解析：題意為「我把隨身行李落在飛機上了」。left在此指粗心遺忘，與forgot意思相符，故答案選D。干擾項A的missing（失蹤）、B的stolen（被偷）與C的checked in（託運）皆與題幹「自己疏忽遺落」的語意不同，為情境字詞陷阱。

questions.stem: We must locate their hideout.

options.A: We must find where they are hiding.
options.B: We must know what they are doing.
options.C: We must decide when to launch an attack.
options.D: We must investigate how to win the war.

questions.explain:
locate: 找出...的位置
hideout: 藏匿處
解析：題意為「我們必須找出他們的藏匿處」。動詞 locate 意為找出位置（find），名詞 hideout 意為藏匿處，同義改寫為 where they are hiding，故答案選A。其餘選項B（在做什麼）、C（何時發起攻擊）與D（如何獲勝）皆屬於軍事作戰情境的過度延伸與干擾，偏離原句尋找地點的字義。

questions.stem: There was never a dull moment at the show.

options.A: It was a very boring show.
options.B: It was a very exciting show.

questions.explain:
dull: 乏味的、無聊的
never a dull moment: 絕無冷場、非常精彩
解析：題意指「這場表演絕無冷場」。never 加上 dull 形成雙重否定，表示過程十分精彩刺激，故答案選B。選項A忽略了否定詞 never，誤解為很無聊；選項C與D則是擅自臆測表演類型（才藝秀、綜藝秀），皆為干擾項。

questions.stem: Kevin looked high and low for his car keys.

options.B: His car keys were found at last.
options.C: His car keys were on the floor.

questions.explain:
look high and low: 到處尋找
missing: 遺失的、找不到的
at last: 終於、最後
解析：題幹片語 look high and low 表示「到處尋找」，說明車鑰匙不見了，故答案選D。選項B說最後找到了，題幹並未提及結果；選項C的地上則是針對 low 的字面陷阱。

questions.stem: M: Do you know what the most important strategic material is, Sergeant Smith? W: I have no idea, sir. What is it? M: Crude oil. Q: Why does the man think crude oil is the most important strategic material?

turns.t: Do you know what the most important strategic material is, Sergeant Smith?
I have no idea, sir. What is it?
Crude oil.
Why does the man think crude oil is the most important strategic material?

questions.explain:
strategic material: 戰略物資
crude oil: 原油
economical: 經濟上的
解析：男士說明原油是最關鍵的戰略物資。原油牽動現代工業、能源與國家命脈，具重大經濟價值，故答案選D。選項A安全、B環保與C健康皆為常識性干擾詞，原油開採甚至常有環保或健康疑慮，均非其作為戰略物資的主要原因。

questions.stem: M: Let's play some computer games. W: I'd rather read a book. Computer games aren't my cup of tea. Q: What does the woman mean?

options.B: She is having a cup of coffee.

turns.t: Let's play some computer games.
I'd rather read a book. Computer games aren't my cup of tea.
What does the woman mean?

questions.explain:
would rather: 寧願
not one's cup of tea: 不感興趣、非某人所好
解析：男士提議玩電腦遊戲，女士表示寧願看書，因為遊戲並非其所好。片語 not one's cup of tea 意為不感興趣或不喜歡，故答案選A。選項B落入 tea 的字面飲料陷阱；選項C對話未提及；選項D誤將想做的事（寧願看書）當成正在進行。

questions.stem: M: What seems to be your problem? W: I feel dizzy all the time. M: don't worry. Let me take your blood pressure first. Then, a nurse will be ready to take your blood sample for analysis. Q: Where is the woman?

turns.t: What seems to be your problem?
I feel dizzy all the time.
don't worry. Let me take your blood pressure first. Then, a nurse will be ready to take your blood sample for analysis.
Where is the woman?

questions.explain:
dizzy: 頭暈的
blood pressure: 血壓
blood sample: 血液樣本
解析：對話中女子表示一直頭暈，男子替她量血壓並由護士安排抽血檢查，這是標準的看病流程，故答案選A。選項B捐血中心與C實驗室是利用對話中的blood與analysis所設下的字面陷阱；D夏令營則與就醫情境完全無關。

questions.stem: M: I need to go to the restroom now. W: Then you'd better hurry up. Our flight is already boarding. M: Don't worry. I'll be back in a few minutes. Q: What are they going to do?

turns.t: I need to go to the restroom now.
Then you'd better hurry up. Our flight is already boarding.
Don't worry. I'll be back in a few minutes.
What are they going to do?

questions.explain:
board: 登機
flight: 班機
get on: 登上（交通工具）
解析：女士提醒航班正在登機（boarding），代表他們即將上飛機，故答案選D。選項A利用restroom的字根rest設下發音與字面陷阱；選項B的下飛機（get off）則與登機語意完全相反。

questions.stem: W: What are we going to do this weekend? M: How about having a barbecue at the beach? W: Sounds like fun. Q: Where will they go this weekend?

turns.t: What are we going to do this weekend?
How about having a barbecue at the beach?
Sounds like fun.
Where will they go this weekend?

questions.explain:
barbecue: 烤肉
beach: 海灘
seaside: 海邊
解析：男方提議週末去海灘（beach）烤肉，女方贊同。beach 與 seaside（海邊）為同義字代換，故答案選D。選項 A 的 bar 是利用 barbecue 前半段發音所設下的陷阱；B 與 C 在對話中則完全未提及。

questions.stem: W: How come you have a crew cut? M: I've joined the army. Q: What does the man mean?

options.D: He has retired from the army.

turns.t: How come you have a crew cut?
I've joined the army.
What does the man mean?

questions.explain:
crew cut: 平頭、三分頭
join the army: 入伍、從軍
retire: 退役、退伍
解析：女方詢問男方為何剪平頭，男方回答他入伍了，代表他現在是軍人，故答案選C。干擾項A藉由crew誘導聯想到機組人員；干擾項B用join混淆成加入俱樂部；干擾項D說他退伍，語意與剛入伍完全相反。

questions.stem: W: I'm sorry. I'm late. M: What happened? W: I don't know what happened, but the traffic was moving at a snail's pace. Q: Why is the woman late?

turns.t: I'm sorry. I'm late.
What happened?
I don't know what happened, but the traffic was moving at a snail's pace.
Why is the woman late?

questions.explain:
at a snail's pace: 極其緩慢地
traffic: 交通車流
解析：女士說車流像蝸牛般移動（moving at a snail's pace），表示車速極慢，故答案選D。選項A車禍、B壞天氣與C施工雖然符合生活常識的塞車原因，但對話中女士已明說「不知道發生什麼事」，這些選項皆為未提及的推論陷阱。

questions.stem: M: Who is the man you were talking to a few minutes ago? W: He's my personal trainer at the gym. Q: Who is the man the woman was talking to?

turns.t: Who is the man you were talking to a few minutes ago?
He's my personal trainer at the gym.
Who is the man the woman was talking to?

questions.explain:
personal trainer: 個人健身教練
gym: 健身房
fitness professional: 健身專業人員
解析：男士詢問女士剛才與誰交談，女士回答是健身房的個人教練。教練屬於健身領域的專業人士，故答案選A。選項B助理、C銷售代表與D親戚皆與健身教練的職業無關，純屬身分上的干擾選項。

questions.stem: W: Your pet is very smart. He can talk like a human. M: Sometimes he can even sing. Q: What does the man most likely keep as a pet?

turns.t: Your pet is very smart. He can talk like a human.
Sometimes he can even sing.
What does the man most likely keep as a pet?

questions.explain:
pet: 寵物
human: 人類
parrot: 鸚鵡
解析：女士稱讚男士的寵物會像人類一樣說話，男士補充說牠有時甚至會唱歌。四個選項中只有鸚鵡具備模仿說話與聲音的能力，故答案選B。選項A鴿子、C猴子與D兔子皆不會開口學人說話，為不合常理的干擾選項。

questions.stem: W: What a pleasant surprise to meet you here! M: I haven't seen you for ages. How have you been? W: Not bad. And you? Q: How would you describe the way they met?

turns.t: What a pleasant surprise to meet you here!
I haven't seen you for ages. How have you been?
Not bad. And you?
How would you describe the way they met?

questions.explain:
pleasant surprise: 令人驚喜的事
for ages: 很久、好長一段時間
coincidence: 巧合、湊巧
解析：題目詢問兩人相遇的方式。女士說在此相遇真是驚喜（pleasant surprise），男士也說好久不見，顯示兩人並非事先約定而是巧遇，故答案選C。選項A的例行會議、B與D的事先安排，均與對話中意外相遇的驚喜感矛盾。

questions.explain:
Bubble economy 泡沫經濟
我們稱它為泡沫經濟，因為經濟基本派的人不支持。
stable 穩定
staple 釘書針

questions.stem: Archeologists spend their lives _______ answers to the world's mysteries.
questions.explain:
archaeologist 考古學家
spend 當動詞用，後面遇到第二個動詞，要動詞加 ing.
Archaeologists spend their lives seeking answers to the world’s mysteries.

questions.stem: North Korea denied that it had launched a _______ to sink the warship.
questions.explain:
單字題; 理解題
tornado 龍捲風
torpedo 魚雷
tuxedo 晚禮服
北韓否認發射魚雷來擊沉戰船。

questions.stem: The mayor had _______ charisma that he was elected again.
questions.explain:
1、So + Adjective / Adverb
2、Such + Noun
比較兩個用法，三個範例如下：
1.
He is so tall.

2.
It’s so hot.
It’s such a hot day.
3.

charisma 是名詞，指非凡的個人魅力。所以用 such

questions.stem: Who your new boyfriend is _______ none of my business.
questions.explain:
文法概念題
(Who your new boyfriend is) is none of my business.
Subject 主詞 動詞

questions.stem: If you are a college student in your second year, you are a _______.
questions.explain:
單字題; 理解題
freshman 大學一年級學生
sophomore 大學二年級學生
junior 大學三年級學生
senior 大學四年級學生

questions.stem: The captain said to the sergeant that the news he told him was _______.
questions.explain:
單字題; 理解題
initial 一開始的
confidential 機密
torrential 傾盆大雨的
presidential 總統的

questions.stem: The four-star general decided to go to the front line to boost the soldiers' _______.
questions.explain:
單字題; 理解題
boost 增強
metal 金屬
morale 士氣
motion 移動，提議
這位四顆星將軍決定到前線去增強士兵的士氣。

questions.stem: Don't _______ the past. You should look ahead.
questions.explain:
單字題
dwell on 駐留
figure out 弄清楚
make up 彌補
Throw away 丟掉

questions.stem: The motorcyclist's life _______ if the ambulance had come earlier.
questions.explain:
摩托車騎士的生命有可能被拯救，如果救護車早點來的話。
摩托車騎士的生命並沒有被救到，所以是與過去事實不符合，要使用過去完
成式加上might.

questions.stem: Jenny has got a master's _______ in physics from Cambridge University.
questions.explain:
單字題; 理解題
degree 學位
grade 分數
status 狀態
title 頭銜
Jenny 已經拿到劍橋大學物理學的碩士學位。

questions.stem: Mr. Stone is not the same man _______ he was five years ago.
questions.explain:
解析: 文法題
關係代名詞用法
關係代名詞主要有who, whom, whose, which, that。關係代名詞身兼代名詞
與連接詞兩種角色。一方面它代替先前出現的先行詞(名詞、代名詞或名詞片
語)
，另一方面它用來引導關係子句，來修飾所替代的先行詞，形成複句。
Mr. Stone is not the same man that he was five years ago.
關代一定要使用【that】的情況
1) 當形容的N為”人+物”時
He is the most handsome teacher that I have ever seen.
The boy and his cat that were taken care of by their baby-sitter went to
the park yesterday.
2) 當形容的N為”最高級”時
The boy and his cat that are walking on the street are my friends.
John is the smartest student that I have ever taught.
3) 當形容的N為”唯一”時
He is the only student that finishes his homework on time.
Christina is his only daughter that he gave most of his property to.
4) 當形容的N為”序數”時
He is the first student that comes here on time.
Chris is the second employee that gets a high raise.
5) 當形容的N為”正是”時
He is the very man that the police wanted.
She is the very daughter that he is looking for.
6) 當形容的N為”相同”時
We study in the same school that has more than 300 students.
We got the same postcard that he sent us.
7) 當形容的N為”thing, nothing, everything, something, anything”時
He has nothing that he wants to share with us.
The thing that he did was really stupid.
PS:
不能使用“that” 的三種情況：
1. My brother Jim, that(who) lives in London , is a doctor.
That不可置於非限定子句內(後有詳述限定子句與非限定子句)
2. The person to that(whom) my father talked yesterday is my teacher.
That不可置於介係詞後
3. The car that (whose) door is broken is my sister's.
That不可取代whose

questions.stem: The 2015 Nepal earthquake occurred at 11:56 on April 25, killing at least 6300 people and injured twice as many as of May 1, 2015.
